description: Save the open project to a .dino file, the same as File > Save. With path: Save As to that file. With name: a new file with that name in the person's projects folder. A project never saved before gets a file in the projects folder. Returns the file path. To save it as a reusable starting point, use templates with save.

name.description: A name for a new file in the projects folder.

name: save_project
